tools.name: find_apps
tools.description: Find free ready-made PriorStates Studio Gallery apps for a need described in plain words, in English, Chinese, Spanish or Portuguese (e.g. 'split a dinner bill', 'keep my receipts for taxes', '分账', 'recibos'). Returns the best matches with what each does, a page link, a screenshot and how to open it

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Full details of one PriorStates Studio Gallery app by id (from find_apps or list_apps): what it does, what it needs (permissions in plain words), its page, screenshot and how to open it.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: Every free app in the PriorStates Studio Gallery, by group (money, side business, home, health, learning, groups, work). Optional group filter by id or name.

tools.name: get_studio
tools.description: What PriorStates Studio is (makes small apps by asking; a Gallery of free apps), the price, and the links for every platform: web, Android (Google Play and APK), iPhone/iPad, macOS/Windows/Linux, Microsoft Store.
